failure.title: Meeting processing failed
failure.cloud_retry_confirm_title: Switch to cloud engine and retry
failure.cloud_retry_confirm_message: The local engine failed to transcribe. Continuing will upload this meeting's audio and transcription data to the cloud service (Alibaba Cloud DashScope) for processing, so the data will leave this device. Task and notes state will be preserved. Switch to cloud and retry?
failure.cloud_retry_failed: Cloud retry failed, please try again later
failure.cloud_retry_blocked_reason: Cloud retry unavailable: this is an intranet-only deployment and meeting data must not leave the device. Check the local engine and retry, or contact your administrator.
